script: The client accepts the work. You send the invoice the same day, and the client pays through the agreed method. You then ask for a review. Each step leaves a record: the written brief, the draft, the message, the invoice and the payment. Keep them in one folder for each client, so that you can find any detail in seconds. Track every payment in your sheet. Write the date, the client, the amount, the method and the fee. Good records make tax filing and budgeting much easier. Never accept payment in a way that gives you no record. Keep a copy of every receipt, screenshot and transfer confirmation.
